jobs.description:
Join our Technology Development team in Svedala and help develop simulation models that improve the performance of our crushing solutions. In this position, you combine analytical work with hands-on verification and testing, while building a detailed understanding of our machine systems and their functionality.  
About your job
As a CAE Engineer, you design, implement and use simulation models to support the development and optimization of our machine systems. Your work ranges from physical modelling and analysis to practical model verification, testing and measurement activities, with close connections to product development.  
Job responsibilities  
Design, implement and use simulation models across different physical domains.  
Develop functionality that supports the design, optimization and improvement of machine systems. 
Verify and validate simulation models through testing and measurement activities. 
Develop algorithms and code related to simulation and modelling.  
Collaborate with design engineers on product improvements and new concepts. 
Contribute to developing our CAE methods, tools and ways of working. 

 
Location and flexibility 
This position is based in Svedala, where Division Crushing Solutions has its global development center for crushers.
Your profile
We’re looking for someone with a strong technical and analytical foundation and an interest in physical modelling and simulation. Experience in developing and validating simulation models enables you to move confidently between theoretical analysis and practical verification.  
Your background includes 
A Master of Science or higher degree in physics, mathematics or mechanical engineering.  
Experience developing simulation models in different physical domains.  
Experience verifying and validating simulation models. 
Experience in algorithm development and coding.  
It’s beneficial if you have experience in testing, as well as experience leading projects or teams.  

You enjoy working with new technology and approaching complex challenges in a structured, analytical and pragmatic way. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and your communication skills help you work effectively across functions, cultures and with both internal and external stakeholders. Just as importantly, you contribute to a positive team spirit.  
The team
You join a small and agile Technology Development team, giving you the opportunity to influence methods, tools and ways of working within CAE. Cross-functional collaboration is a natural part of your day, connecting you with colleagues and stakeholders across our organization.
Our culture
Sandvik is so much more than an engineering group in the manufacturing industry. We’re a global company with many opportunities for personal and professional development – and great benefits. We’ve been an employer to trust for 160 years, and our reward philosophy states that remuneration and other employment conditions should align with local market practice, be competitive, and reflect responsibility and performance. We have a clear objective of being a leader within digital solutions in our industry and we focus on growing our digital customer offering. To get there, we work towards an even more diverse and inclusive organization – because we’re sure that differences improve Sandvik's business and creates a culture of innovation.

jobs.description:

Our leaders are the engine for bringing inclusion and diversity of thought to life and we need you who want to be a part of our journey! 
HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a business unit within Hitachi Energy that develops, manufactures and sells DC transmission systems to customers worldwide. HVDC technology is used to transmit electrical energy over long distances with minimal losses. HVDC is also used to connect different power systems.  
GI Valves (HVDC) in Ludvika is now looking for a Production Supervisor that wants to engage and grow a diverse team of assemblers in our Valve production. You will have a central part of ensuring quality and delivery of projects and to support your team to develop themselves as well as the organization. We offer you an exciting and dynamic role with close collaboration with other departments and teams at Hitachi Energy. 
How you’ll make an impact   
You will be part of The Valve Assembly production unit and have responsibility for the work environment and workflow of about 20 people. 
Your important mission will be to enable your employees to grow and develop with safe and agile leadership. 
You share Hitachi Energy’s core values ​​of safety and integrity, which means you take responsibility for your own actions while feeling responsible for your colleagues and business. 
You will ensure the right capacity and competence for your production area to meet set deadlines and goals. 
You will also be responsible for running the department's improvement work and activities

Your background

You are a driven person with technical education or equivalent work experience who has a good understanding of production flows, where knowledge within Hitachi Energy and our product is meritorious. 
You have a wish to grow in a leadership role. If you have experience of project management or other leadership roles it is a merit. 
Through continuous improvement in mind, you can handle change with energy, joy and commitment. 
You also have quality- and result focus and believe that collaboration is the key to success. 
Knowing Swedish is required for collaboration with local stakeholders. As you will be part of a company that operates on a global arena, fluent in English is preferable.

Gnutti Carlo Group Sweden is looking for an experienced Country Quality Manager to lead and further develop our Quality organization and quality performance in Sweden.
This is a senior leadership position with overall responsibility for Quality across our Swedish operations. The role reports directly to the Managing Director Sweden and is a member of the Swedish Management Team.
The successful candidate will combine strategic leadership with a hands-on understanding of manufacturing, customer requirements, process quality and continuous improvement.
The Role
As Country Quality Manager, you will lead the Swedish Quality organization and drive the continued development of quality performance across our operations.
Your responsibility covers Customer Quality, Supplier Quality, Quality Assurance and Process Quality, with a strong focus on robust processes, preventive quality and continuous improvement.
You will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, Supply Chain and Production Development, as well as with the Quality Management System organization.
A key part of the role is to strengthen quality ownership throughout the organization and ensure that quality is built into our processes.
You will represent Quality in the Swedish Management Team and act as a senior quality interface with customers, suppliers and the wider Gnutti Carlo Group.
Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Quality organization and quality agenda in Sweden.

Develop the capabilities and ways of working within Customer Quality, Supplier Quality, Quality Assurance and Process Quality.

Drive Customer Quality, including customer relationships, claims, structured problem solving, corrective actions and effectiveness verification.

Strengthen Quality Assurance and Process Quality, including quality gates, control plans, process controls and verification methods.

Drive preventive quality, process capability and manufacturing robustness in close cooperation with Operations and Engineering.

Ensure effective application of automotive quality methods including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA and 8D.

Strengthen Quality involvement in new products, process changes, industrialization and production launches.

Lead and develop Supplier Quality together with Purchasing and Engineering, focusing on supplier performance and preventive quality development.

Drive reduction of customer claims, internal defects, scrap, rework and Cost of Poor Quality through structured problem solving, lessons learned and sustainable corrective actions.

Establish and follow clear quality KPIs, priorities and management routines, strengthening quality ownership and accountability throughout the organization.

Work closely with the Quality Management System organization to ensure alignment between system requirements and operational execution.

Lead and support the Quality organization, ensuring structured processes, fact-based analysis and effective actions.

Your Profile
We are looking for an experienced quality leader with a strong background in the automotive industry.
You understand quality from both a technical and leadership perspective and are comfortable working close to manufacturing while maintaining the broader perspective required for a country-level management position.
We believe you have:

Several years of leadership experience within Quality in the automotive industry.

Experience as a senior Quality Manager, Plant Quality Manager, Quality Director or equivalent.

Strong knowledge of automotive quality requirements and IATF 16949.

Solid experience with APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA and 8D.

Strong experience in Customer Quality, Supplier Quality and structured problem solving.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, process capability and preventive quality.

Experience in leading and developing teams in an international manufacturing environment.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate quality data into priorities and actions.

Fluent English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Leadership Profile
We are looking for a leader who is visible in the operation, understands manufacturing reality and is comfortable moving between management-level discussions, customer interaction and the factory floor.
You are structured, fact-based and pragmatic. You create clear ownership and expectations, challenge existing ways of working and follow through until actions deliver the intended result.
Most importantly, you understand that sustainable quality performance is built through strong processes, technical understanding, prevention, clear ownership and disciplined execution.
What We Offer
This position offers the opportunity to take a central role in the continued development of Quality within Gnutti Carlo Group Sweden.
As Country Quality Manager, you will have a strong mandate to influence the Quality organization, our ways of working and the long-term development of quality performance across our Swedish operations.
You will work closely with the Managing Director, the Swedish Management Team and key functions across the organization, while interacting with customers, suppliers and the wider Gnutti Carlo Group

The opportunity
At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future by delivering innovative technologies that make power systems more resilient, efficient, and sustainable. As a global leader in High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) technology, we enable the transmission of renewable energy across countries and continents, supporting the transition toward a carbon-neutral future.
We are now looking for an R&D Senior Engineer to join our MACH R&D organization within HVDC. In this role, you will contribute to the development of one of the world's most advanced control and protection platforms for power transmission systems.
For more than 60 years, Hitachi Energy has been pioneering HVDC technology. At the heart of every HVDC system is MACH™, our industry-leading control and protection platform, designed to provide reliable operation around the clock for decades.
As part of our global R&D organization, you will work closely with colleagues in Sweden and India to develop next-generation embedded solutions for HVDC systems. In this senior role, you will serve as a key technical contributor, driving complex technical solutions, influencing architectural decisions, mentoring colleagues, and contributing to the continued evolution of the MACH™ platform.
How you'll make an impact
Develop and maintain embedded software solutions for the MACH™ control and protection platform used in HVDC systems worldwide.
Take technical ownership of functionality throughout the product lifecycle, from concept and design to testing, verification, and release.
Contribute to software architecture decisions and drive technical improvements that support long-term product performance and sustainability.
Collaborate closely with software, hardware, FPGA, system, and verification engineers in cross-functional R&D teams.
Support system integration, troubleshooting, and optimization of real-time embedded applications.
Participate in technology investigations and contribute to future product and platform development.
Share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and help strengthen technical excellence across the organization.
Collaborate with global stakeholders while living Hitachi Energy's values of safety and integrity.

Your background
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Embedded Systems, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Several years of experience in embedded software development within complex industrial, real-time, or mission-critical systems.
Strong programming skills in C/C++ and solid experience with embedded systems architecture and real-time operating systems.
Experience working with Git, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, and modern software development practices.
Good understanding of software development processes, testing methodologies, verification, and quality assurance.
Experience in electronics design, communication protocols, and system-level troubleshooting.
Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python is considered an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with excellent communication abilities and professional fluency in English.

More about us

Great procurement goes beyond negotiating a better price. It connects business needs, supplier expertise and market insight to create lasting value. Ready to put that into practice across an international manufacturing business?

At DS Smith, we are looking for a Sub-Regional Procurement Category Manager to develop and implement procurement strategies across manufacturing, commodities and pallets in North & East EMEA. You will help shape a competitive and sustainable supply base that supports our packaging operations, innovation and business growth.

About the role
You will shape and deliver procurement strategies for manufacturing, commodities and pallets across North & East EMEA. Reporting to the Sub-Regional Procurement Lead East & North EMEA, you will work with local and global procurement colleagues, Operations and Engineering to lead sourcing, negotiations and supplier partnerships across manufacturing inputs, maintenance services and capital equipment.
Combining international category responsibility with practical impact at site level, you will improve cost, working capital, supplier performance and resilience while supporting innovation and sustainability. This is an opportunity to influence how we source the materials, equipment and services our manufacturing sites rely on.
The role will be based at one of our offices or sites in Sweden or Denmark, with travel of up to 30%. Posible locations: Värnamo, Mariestad or Gothenburg, in Sverige; Grenaa or Taastrup, in Denmark.

About you
You bring procurement category management experience within manufacturing or packaging, including category strategy, complex sourcing and negotiations. Commercially minded and analytical, you turn market insight into practical solutions and build strong relationships across functions and countries to deliver results.
You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification and are fluent in English as well as Swedish or Danish. Experience with SAP and Coupa, additional European languages, and CIPS or an equivalent procurement qualification would be advantageous.

About us
DS Smith is a leading provider of sustainable fiber-based packaging worldwide, which is supported by recycling and papermaking operations. We play a central role in the value chain across sectors including e-commerce, fast moving consumer goods and industrials. 
Through our purpose of ‘Redefining Packaging for a Changing World’ and our Now and Next sustainability strategy, DS Smith is committed to leading the transition to the circular economy. We are delivering more and more circular solutions for our customers and wider society – replacing problem plastics, taking carbon out of supply chains and providing innovative recycling solutions. Our history can be traced back to the box-making businesses started in the 1940s by the Smith family. Today, DS Smith is headquartered in London and a member of the FTSE 100, operating in 34 countries employing around 30,000 people.

Your future workplace
DS Smith is focusing on realizing the potential of our people every day, and you will get close to endless opportunities for independent prioritization of your day-to-day work in a good work environment with colleagues of all ages and nationalities. Like all other DS Smith colleagues, we are proud of the opportunity to make a sustainable difference in a market-leading company. But we also consider our colleagues as individuals and would like to make their lives healthier and happier, therefore we offer our colleagues a range of benefits.

Fair recruitment in DS Smith
Don’t meet every single requirement? At DS Smith, we are committed to recruiting across a wide range of candidates. We are thriving for being a diverse workplace where everyone can realize their potential. We see equality and diversity as a strength. Thus, we hope that you will apply for the position even if you do not necessarily meet all the requirements.

Would you like to know more?
This full-time position can be based at one of our sites in either Sweden or Denmark, with travels between sites to be expected. Accession as soon as possible.
If you want to know more about this role, contact our Head of Procurement Leader East & North EMEA, Jeremy Freyne: jeremy.freyne@dssmith.com
If you have questions regarding the process or trouble applying, please reach out to us at nordic.recruitment@dssmith.com

jobs.occupation: Postdoktor vid avdelningen för molekylär skelettbiologi
jobs.description:
Workplace descriptionThe projects will be performed within the Cell, Tissue and Organ Engineering group led by Dr. Paul Bourgine. Bone is a complex Organ offering structural and mechanical support of our body but also consisting in our principal hematopoietic center. The formation of Bone involves distinct stages, including cartilage, vasculature, bone and bone marrow establishment. The Bourgine lab aims at compiling human-specific knowledge on these processes, toward the development of innovative Regenerative Therapies.
Within the research group, we are committed to fostering a positive work environment characterized by respect and consideration in our relationships with one another. We continuously strive to create conditions that promote job satisfaction, professional development, and inclusion for all employees.
We are now seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher for a full-time fixed-term position, with a start date of 1st of February 2027 or by agreement.
What we offerLund University is a government agency, which means you will receive special benefits, generous annual leave, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university’s website about working at Lund University: Work with us.
Duties and responsibilitiesThe Postdoctoral Researcher will work with the following tasks:
Development of novel culture systems for tissue engineering.
Isolation and differentiation of primary human cells.
Identification of cellular and molecular events throughout stages of endochondral ossification.

Other responsibilities and work tasks may also be relevant.
Eligibility requirementsTo be eligible for a postdoctoral position, you must have a PhD or a foreign degree deemed equivalent to a PhD. This requirement must be fulfilled at the time of the employment decision, and proof must be submitted by that date. Exceptions can be made in cases such as parental leave, illness, clinical duties, union commitments, or similar.
Assessment criteriaAt Lund University, postdoctoral positions are intended to provide opportunities for academic qualification. The position primarily allows for research merit, but also includes limited higher education teaching. Teaching may be included in the role. The main assessment criterion is scientific expertise in the subject area.
Required qualificationsThe position requires:
PhD in Biology or Bioengineering
Documented postdoctoral experiences in different laboratories
At least three publications as first author in a peer-reviewed journal 
Documented experience in vascular biology and engineering of vessels
Robust experience in 3D culture applied to ossification
Strong laboratory and analytical skills, with the ability to work both independently and within an interdisciplinary team.
Robust experience in culture and differentiation of human primary cells in 2D and 3D
Experience in microfluidics and microscopy
Experience in prototyping with AutoCAD
Good knowledge of English (written and spoken).

Merits include:
Experience with human mesenchymal cell culture and differentiation
Background in biomaterials science and/or polymer synthesis.
Experience with 3D printing/additive manufacturing and associated software
Experience as executive member of scientific societies 

Terms of employment
This is a fixed-term, full-time position for two years, starting on 2027-02-01 or as agreed.Employment at Lund University takes place in Sweden, and you are therefore expected to carry out your work on site in Lund.
The appointment is limited to a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years, in accordance with the collective agreement on fixed-term employment as a postdoc (Arbetsgivarverket). A postdoctoral position is intended as an initial step in a research career and an opportunity to deepen and broaden research expertise.
Application instructionsYour application should include:
A cover letter describing your interest in the project, how you meet the required qualifications (including previous independent projects and technical skills), your research interests, and your future career plans
A CV including names and contact details of two former supervisors
A complete publication list (can be included in your CV)
A copy of your diploma (PhD or equivalent)

We warmly welcome your application!
Mer om Medicinska fakulteten
Medicinska fakulteten är ett verksamhetsområde inom Lunds universitet, med ansvar för utbildning och forskning inom medicin, vård och hälsa. Utbildningen sker i nära samverkan med sjukvården och är väl förankrad i fakultetens starka forskningstradition. Fakultetens forskning spänner över ett brett fält inom experimentell grundforskning, patientnära klinisk forskning och hälsovetenskaplig forskning. Medicinska fakulteten, med drygt 1800 anställda och 3000 studenter i Lund, Malmö och Helsingborg, är en kunskapsintensiv mötesplats för studenter, lärare och forskare från hela världen.
Vi undanber oss alla kontakter från annonsförsäljare, rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag på grund av statliga upphandlingsregler.

You are pragmatic and commercially minded, combining sound legal judgment with a structured approach to compliance. You enjoy working independently, taking responsibility, and finding practical solutions in a fast-moving international business. Experience from semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, defense-related industries, or other highly regulated technology sectors is an advantage.What we offer you:
Close collaboration with management and specialist colleagues.

The opportunity to take ownership, shape and structure our legal and trade compliance processes.

Knowledge exchange with technical experts, connecting advanced MEMS technology with legal and trade compliance.

As part of this team, you will work with some of the world’s largest technology giants and innovation leaders in industries such as medicine, life sciences, consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, and industrial sectors.Additional Information We have an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. jobs.description:
Company Description
Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.

3D CAD Models:

Product testing

Technical documentation

Education:

Experience in specification of new components, material selection, manufacturability, tolerance chain calculation.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Results-oriented, proactive, and committed to delivering
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

We are looking for a researcher in Psychology for a fixed-term position at the School of Behavioral, Social and Legal Sciences (BSR). The research is within the area of cognitive neuroscience of aging.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Psychology.
Background
The Division of Psychology at Örebro University is part of the School of Behavioural, Social and Legal Sciences (BSR), together with the Divisions of Legal Science, Criminology, and Social Work.
Örebro university is now hiring a researcher within the area of cognitive neuroscience of aging, with a particular focus on early life predictors of brain structural and functional connectivity in older age. The research will be conducted within the research environment LEADER (Center for Lifespan Developmental Research), which is headed by Jonas Persson, Professor in Psychology.
Duties and responsibilities
The research duties include preprocessing and analyses of structural and functional brain imaging data obtained by magnetic resonance imaging. A particular focus will be on analysing diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) data to assess structural connectivity and brain network properties in older age and how these related to health, cognition, lifestyle and other factors in childhood and adolescence. Analyses of functional connectivity data from resting-state fMRI images and the relationship with early life predictors is also expected. The applicant will also have a leading role in dissemination of the results through international peer-reviewed publication and presentations.  
Qualifications
Those qualified for the appointment as a researcher are applicants who have obtained a doctoral degree or have a degree from abroad deemed to correspond to a doctoral degree.
Assessment criteria
A general basis for assessment is that the applicant is able to demonstrate the personal qualities required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities at hand; that they are able to cooperate with other members of staff; and contribute to the development of university operations.
Specific personal abilities that are of great importance for the position is documented expertise in the fields of cognitive aging and brain imaging. Of particular importance is proficiency in analysing structural brain connectivity data, connectome-based modelling and tractography of diffusion-tensor imaging (DTI)/DWI data combined with a documented ability in analysing functional MRI data. Experience of working with longitudinal MRI data is also highly desirable, along with experience in working with software such as Matlab, R and SPM.
Information
This is a fixed-term full-time position for 12 months. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience.
For more information about the position, contact Jonas Persson +46 19 301428, email: jonas.persson@oru.se, or Head of Unit Terese Glatz, +46 19 301205, email: terese.glatz@oru.se.
At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.
Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.
Application
The application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.
For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:
Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
Account of research qualifications and experience
Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed.

Want to help shape the future of professional robotic lawn care? Join our Pro Robotic R&D team and work hands-on with robotic mowers used in demanding professional environments.
Our team develops and maintains robotic mower solutions for customers such as football clubs, parks, commercial properties and golf courses. Reliability, efficiency and consistent performance are essential, and that is where our System Test team comes in.

As a System Tester, you will be part of the System and Test team, verifying system behaviour, functionality and overall product quality.

This is a hands-on role where you will test our robotic products in real field environments, simulated and lab environments, as well as through automated test pipelines. You will work closely with system engineers, software and product development teams, and other test functions to understand how the complete system performs. Your responsibilities will include:
Verifying new functionality and bug fixes in field and lab environments
Performing regression and acceptance testing
Identifying, analysing and documenting deviations from requirements
Tracking test progress and ensuring coverage against requirements
Contributing to improved test methods, workflows and ways of working

The exact focus of the role can be adapted based on your previous experience, technical strengths and areas where you want to continue developing.
You will travel approximately four times per year, with each trip lasting around two weeks.

Furthermore, take ownership of your work, know how to prioritise and enjoy collaborating across different engineering disciplines in a dynamic R&D environment.

At least 2 years of experience testing embedded products
A B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Software Development, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering or a related field
Professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written, Swedish is a plus
A Swedish B driving licence
The possibility to travel

System-level test automation
Data analytics
Linux and/or ROS

About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to take ownership of CI/CD infrastructure and automation supporting embedded software development and cloud-based services.
You will work in a technically diverse engineering environment, with a primary focus on maintaining, developing and optimizing a locally hosted CI/CD platform built around Jenkins, Docker and Gerrit.
The role also involves working with Azure DevOps pipelines and deploying web services across AWS and Azure cloud environments.
We are looking for a technically strong professional who can independently drive infrastructure improvements, optimize development workflows and ensure stable, secure and efficient software delivery processes.
Key Responsibilities
1. CI/CD Infrastructure & Platform Management
Maintain, operate and continuously improve the existing CI/CD infrastructure based on Jenkins, Docker and Gerrit.
Ensure the stability, reliability, security and scalability of build and deployment environments.
Manage and optimize container-based build environments.
Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and implement improvements to increase efficiency and performance.
Take ownership of the overall CI/CD platform and its continuous development.

2. Jenkins Pipeline Development & Automation
Develop, maintain and optimize Jenkins pipelines.
Implement Pipeline-as-Code using Declarative and Scripted Groovy.
Develop and maintain Jenkins Shared Libraries.
Build automation solutions using Groovy and Python.
Integrate automated build, testing and code review workflows.

3. Static Code Analysis & Quality Automation
Integrate and maintain static code analysis tools within build and code review processes.
Work with tools such as CodeChecker and cppcheck.
Improve automated code quality checks and development workflows.
Ensure static analysis tools are effectively integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

4. Azure DevOps & Cloud Deployment
Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines using YAML.
Manage deployment workflows for web-based services.
Support application deployment across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
Improve automation, reliability and efficiency of cloud deployment processes.
Collaborate with development teams to streamline software delivery.

5. Linux Administration & Technical Support
Perform Linux system administration and infrastructure maintenance.
Troubleshoot CI/CD platform issues and resolve technical challenges.
Document infrastructure architecture, processes and operational procedures.
Support developers in using CI/CD tools and automation workflows.
Independently plan, prioritize and execute technical improvements.

Required Skills & Experience
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps and CI/CD engineering.
Expert-level knowledge of Jenkins, including:
Declarative and Scripted Pipelines.
Groovy programming.
Pipeline-as-Code.
Jenkins Shared Libraries.
Strong experience with Docker and container-based build environments.
Experience with Gerrit or equivalent Git-based code review platforms and CI integration.
Good programming and automation skills using Python.
Practical experience developing Azure DevOps YAML pipelines.
Experience deploying and managing applications across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
Experience integrating static code analysis tools such as CodeChecker, cppcheck or equivalent solutions.
Strong knowledge of Linux system administration.
Ability to independently manage technical responsibilities, prioritize activities and drive improvements.
Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with software development teams.
Fluent in English and good proficiency in Swedish, both written and spoken.

Volvo Energy is a young company in the Volvo Group which supports customers in the electrical energy transition. Volvo Energy develops and commercializes competitive Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and provides customers with reliable solutions which optimize energy costs, operational resilience, and renewable energy integration.
  
 We are now looking for a new colleague to join our team at Volvo Energy as Project Manager BESS installations.
 What are we looking for in this specific role? 
In this role, we are looking for an experienced project manager who can lead BESS installation projects from contract signature through energization, final acceptance, and handover. You combine strong project leadership with practical understanding of construction, electrical infrastructure, commissioning, and site execution.
  
 You are a self-motivated and results-driven team player who creates structure in complex projects and works effectively with customers, contractors, suppliers, grid owners, authorities, and internal technical or project teams. You are comfortable taking ownership of scope, schedule, cost, risk, safety, quality, and stakeholder coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
  
 Responsibilities include:
  Own project scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, and execution, with regular reporting to project stakeholders.
 Develop and maintain the integrated project schedule covering permits, supplier deliveries, civil and electrical works, grid owner activities, compliance testing, commissioning, and energization milestones.
 Procure and manage installation, civil, and electrical contractors together with the design and Purchasing teams, ensuring execution according to approved designs, specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.
 Serve as the primary point of contact for project execution, coordinating customers, grid owners, authorities, contractors, suppliers, aggregators, and other stakeholders.
 Lead site activities during construction, commissioning, and testing, including contractor coordination, site safety, site rules, BAS-U responsibilities, FAT, transport, lifting, SAT, system integration, compliance activities, and energization.
 Manage project risks, changes, interfaces, claims, variation orders, time extensions, and contractual milestones throughout execution.
 Lead project close-out through punch list closure, final acceptance, customer and service handover, and delivery of required documentation and training.
 Maintain a site presence aligned with project needs, particularly during critical construction, commissioning, testing, and energization activities.
  
 
 Who are you? 
Expected qualifications:
  Degree in Engineering, or equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience.
 Previous project management experience within energy, electrical infrastructure, construction, or industrial projects.
 Experience in BESS, renewable energy, grid connection, or similar infrastructure projects, including installation and commissioning.
 Understanding of project contracts, preferably ABT 06 and AB 04.
 Self-motivated, structured, and results-driven, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills and the ability to engage teams and partners in a changing project environment.
 Fluent in Swedish and English.
 Willingness to be present on site when required.
  
 
 Meriting:
  Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
 Experience acting as BAS-U.

 What you will do

You combine strong power system knowledge with hands-on experience in PowerFactory and can translate grid code and grid owner requirements into technical studies, testing activities, and approval documentation.
  
 You are structured, analytical, and comfortable taking technical ownership. You are a team player who works effectively with DSOs, TSOs, customers, suppliers, aggregators, consultants, and internal project and product teams.

  Lead the RfG and grid connection process for BESS projects, from requirement clarification through ION, EON, FON, compliance testing, and final approval.
 Act as the primary technical interface towards DSOs, TSOs, and other grid stakeholders throughout the grid connection process.
 Perform and coordinate PowerFactory, EMT, harmonic, protection, and other power system studies required to demonstrate compliance with grid code and connection requirements.
 Prepare simulation reports, compliance documentation, and technical submissions required for grid owner approvals and operational notifications.
 Coordinate compliance testing, witness testing, and verification activities with grid owners, suppliers, and project teams.
 Support supplier selection, design reviews, and technical requirements to ensure BESS systems meet applicable grid code and connection requirements.
 Lead aggregator sourcing, technical integration, and prequalification activities where required.
